linkedin:
> Run Node on `localhost:3000` and put nginx in front on 443.

nginx terminates TLS, serves your static files, and proxies everything else with `proxy_pass` to `127.0.0.1:3000`, forwarding `Host`, `X-Real-IP`, `X-Forwarded-For`, and `X-Forwarded-Proto` so your app sees the real client. Add the `Upgrade` and `Connection` headers and WebSockets work too. On managed hosting the platform runs this proxy and the SSL for you.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/nginx-reverse-proxy-for-node/
